name: Renee Snider
prior_offices: Carbon County assessor (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Renee Snider is the Carbon County assessor and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official assessor page lists her in that office. The Rawlins Times reported that she was among the county officials who won at the polls.

sources.name: Rawlins Times, Nov. 4, 2026, Carbon County sees no real surprises in 2026 midterm elections
